_comment: The detector-first decision rule's numbers (A36, vision/rules.py RuleConfig).
play_min and small_group_max are the facility's requirement, not fits. detector/imgsz/tiles
name the model the counts come from (vision/detector.DETECTORS): yolov8n at 1280, untiled,
chosen 2026-09-19 by experiments/detector_audit.py under the rule registered in A36 -
best |d|<=1 (0.700) on 100 hand-counted frames among the configurations whose round fits
the cycle, then false-person rate, then latency. Tiling was measured and refused: it takes
ball recall 0.43 -> 0.59 and count agreement 0.70 -> 0.38, and the rule reads the count.
Every other threshold is fitted on venue_01 camera A only
by experiments/fit_rule_thresholds.py (WP9-T5) and then frozen: frozen_at, frozen_commit
and tuned_on record when, from what, and on which camera. A null threshold means the cue
it gates is not consulted. While frozen_at is null the worker refuses to deploy this file;
experiments run against it, since measuring an unfrozen rule is how it gets frozen.
